banned_page.label: Account access restricted
banned_page.title: Your account has been banned
banned_page.description: Your FullParty account has been banned. You can no longer access features that require you to be signed in.
banned_page.help: If you think this decision was unfair or you are unsure why you were banned, join the FullParty Discord and contact our staff. We can help clarify what happened and review your concerns.

title: Report content
description: Choose the reason for your report. Only website administrators can review it.
thanks: Thanks for your report. Our administrators will review it and notify you of the outcome.
feedback_description: An administrator has reviewed your report.
feedback_remaining: You have {count} moderation updates to acknowledge.
owner_notice_description: An administrator changed the visibility of content you manage.
hidden_editor_notice: This resource is hidden by an administrator. You can save and publish corrections, but only an administrator can make it visible again.

owner_notice.hidden: Content you manage, “{item}”, has been hidden by a FullParty administrator. It will remain hidden until an administrator restores it.
owner_notice.restored: The moderation restriction on content you manage, “{item}”, has been lifted by a FullParty administrator. Its usual publication and access settings now apply.

feedback.hidden: The content you reported, “{item}”, has been hidden by an administrator.
feedback.banned: The account responsible for the content you reported, “{item}”, has been banned.
feedback.action_taken: We reviewed your report about “{item}” and took appropriate action.
feedback.no_violation: We reviewed your report about “{item}” and did not find a violation requiring action.
feedback.already_unavailable: We reviewed your report about “{item}”. This content is no longer available.

errors.already_open: A newer review is already open for this content. Continue in that case instead.
errors.protected_account: Administrator accounts and your own account cannot be banned here.
errors.banned: Your account has been banned. You cannot use authenticated features.
errors.claim_first: Assign this case to yourself and review it before continuing.
errors.stale: This case changed. Reload it and review the latest evidence before continuing.
errors.feedback_mismatch: Choose feedback that matches the recorded moderation action.
errors.rate_limit: Too many reports. Please try again later.
errors.submit: Your report could not be submitted. Check that the content is still available and try again.
errors.acknowledge: Your acknowledgement could not be saved. Please try closing this message again.
errors.load: Could not load this case. Please try again.
errors.action: The action could not be completed. Reload the case and check your selection.
errors.session_expired: Your session expired. Refresh this page and try again.

admin.reversible: This review is complete, but its decisions can be reversed. Restore content or unban the account below, or reopen the review to reconsider the decision. If a newer review is already open, continue there.
admin.title: Reports
admin.description: Review reported content, record actions, and send feedback.
admin.review_description: Report evidence and reporter identities are visible only to website administrators.
admin.target_missing: The original content is no longer available. The report evidence is retained.
admin.context_target: This content type supports review and account actions. Direct hiding is not available for this type.
admin.internal_reason: Internal reason (not sent to the reporter)
admin.confirm_action: Confirm this moderation action. It will be recorded in the admin audit log.
admin.confirm_account: This affects the account “{name}” across FullParty.
admin.hidden_preview: Hidden from users. This preview is visible only to website administrators.
admin.no_responsible_account: No responsible account is recorded for this content.
admin.responsible_help: Account actions affect this recorded account. Group ownership alone does not establish who authored the reported content.
admin.snapshot_help: Each report keeps the content captured when it was submitted. Compare it with the current content above. Embedded image references are retained; uploaded-image reports also retain the image itself.
admin.saved_content: Content at the time of this report
admin.guest_reference_help: This reference groups guest reports from the same network. It does not identify an individual person.
admin.guest_feedback_notice: Guest reporters cannot receive notifications. The outcome will still be recorded here.

guest_thanks: Thanks for your report. Our administrators will review it.
guest_notice: You can report without an account. Reports from the same network share anti-spam limits. Guest reporters cannot receive follow-up notifications.
